title: Origins: Sylph
description: Living beings blessed by the wind, Sylphs can flit and float wherever the wind takes them.
body:
**This datapack is designed for the Origins mod.**

**Sylphs:** Living beings blessed by the wind, Sylphs can flit and float wherever the wind takes them. Though their light weight makes them less effective in melee, their enhanced movement makes them formidible as long as they have room to dart around.

**Impact: 🟢**

🟩 **Triple Jump [Jump]:** Drawing upon the wind, you can boost yourself 2 additional times while in midair.

🟢 **Airtime:** While drawing a bow or holding a loaded crossbow the wind holds you aloft, allowing you to hover for a short time.

🟢 **Air Cushion:** The wind catches you when you fall, reducing the fall damage you take.

🔴 **Gentle Touch:** The wind around you works against you in melee, weakening your attacks.

🔴 **Featherweight:** Your lighter weight causes hits to toss you into the air.

_No AI was knowingly using in the creation of this project._
